# ADR-3054: A05: Directory listing enablement for static host 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Listings reveal sensitive paths and backups.

## Decision

Static hosts SHALL NOT allow a directory listing enablement for static host 6 (A05-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Indexes are disabled by default.
